decisions.reason: Full correct version history (A1-02 temporary removal, A2-01 restore/revert) beyond bare card names, plus the rollup fold rule, applied to produceExternalEvent in src/events.ts.

Locates delete (event as any).ignorable at events.ts:6, rejects the keep-stripping comment as a trap, recommends removal, distinguishes removing the defense from removing the marker itself, and notes the delete is dead code on the shown literal.

Explains ignorable:true is only for informational events old readers may omit without harming reconstruction, that the marker is not a consumer-side filter and events remain in the loaded log, and applies this to the producer while respecting the live-append limitation.

Identifies that public live Session.append has no ignorable parameter, forbids faking via casts or hand-edited persistence, recommends a sidecar store and defers third-party persistent events until a supported append mechanism ships.
